reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 33. Nay or No: 7. Not Voting: 0. Of 40 Yea or Nay votes where the Republican majority could be computed, 38 (95%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 210 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.

It was a pleasure sitting in on a few Military Service Academy nomination interviews and hearing from some impressive young leaders about their goals! Every year, my office has the privilege of nominating the best and the brightest students in OH-02, each of them having already demonstrated excellence in academics, extracurricular activities, and leadership among their peers.

Thank you to each distinguished member of our panel who took time to interview these students. They certainly have bright futures ahead of them, and I look forward to seeing what they’ll accomplish down the road!

We are grateful for his unwavering leadership and dedication to serving the great people of OH-02.

Happy Birthday, Congressman Taylor! https://t.co/wmfQ0llIDr

My office is monitoring the FAA nationwide ground stop. We’re grateful to @SecDuffy, @DHSgov, and our skilled air traffic controllers for their swift efforts to respond to this issue.

American families deserve to know they’re sharing the road with CDL drivers who are properly trained, vetted, and equipped to operate heavy commercial vehicles in a way that keeps everyone safe.

I’m proud to introduce the CDL Fraud Tipline Act to keep unqualified drivers off our roads. By calling 866-347-2423, Americans can report suspected CDL fraud and make sure every American family on the road gets home safe. 

As the Founder of the Congressional Trucking Caucus, I will continue working to ensure our highways are safe for generations to come!

Today, I proudly voted in support of the Major Richard Star Act to ensure our combat veterans receive the full retired pay and disability compensation they deserve.

In Congress, I will always stand up for our heroes. They have put our country first, and now it’s our turn to return the favor!

Ohio has one of the largest veteran populations in the nation, and I will always have the backs of our heroes. 🇺🇸 

My office is still accepting applications for a veteran or Gold Star Family member to fill a veteran casework role in my district office. The selected individual will serve as a liaison between veteran constituents and federal, state, and local agencies.

Interested candidates should submit an application online. If you or someone you know would be a good fit for this role, my team would love to connect with you! 

https://t.co/3qGz4VhXmy

We owe an immeasurable debt of gratitude to the brave men and women who have stepped up to the plate in service to our country.

This Veterans Day, we honor Buckeye veterans and all who have sacrificed so much to protect the freedoms we hold dear. In Congress, I will always stand with our heroes to ensure they have the benefits, care, and support they’ve earned through their service.

May God bless our veterans, their families, and the USA! 🇺🇸
Looking forward to working with @RepLisaMcClain as she continues her excellent leadership as House Conference Chair! Proud to stand alongside you as we work together for a better future.
Congratulations to Tom Emmer on being elected House Minority Whip! 🇺🇸 I look forward to working together to deliver results for Buckeye and American families!

Congratulations to @Jim_Jordan, our next Minority Leader!

I look forward to working with Jim to stand up for common sense policies and be a strong voice for Ohioans in Congress! 🇺🇸
